o.norm: 07-Mar-2017, tatu: Important to distinguish "none" from 'empty' value...

i.norm:
Tests for {@link JsonTypeInfo.Value#from(JsonTypeInfo)} covering the null-annotation case.

It is important that a {@code null} annotation produces a {@code null} Value, rather than the shared {@code EMPTY} sentinel, so callers can distinguish "no annotation present" from "annotation present but using defaults".
Passing {@code null} to {@link JsonTypeInfo.Value#from} must return {@code null}, not an empty/default {@link JsonTypeInfo.Value} instance.
